title: Speaking Practice 26 - Urbanization
description: IELTS Speaking Part 3: Discussion questions about urbanization.

stimuli.title: Part 3: Urbanization Discussion
stimuli.content: In Part 3, the examiner asks abstract questions. Give extended answers with examples.

questionGroups.instruction: Discuss the following questions. Give detailed answers with examples.

questions.content: Why are more people moving to cities?

explanation.sampleAnswer: Cities offer better job opportunities, higher salaries, and access to education and healthcare. Young people especially are attracted by the vibrant social life and career prospects.

questions.content: What problems does rapid urbanization cause?

explanation.sampleAnswer: Overcrowding, traffic congestion, pollution, and housing shortages are major issues. In Ho Chi Minh City, for example, traffic jams are a daily reality for millions.

questions.content: Do you think life in the countryside is better than in the city?

explanation.sampleAnswer: It depends on priorities. The countryside offers peace, clean air, and stronger community bonds, while cities provide convenience and opportunities. Neither is objectively better.

questions.content: How can cities be made more livable?

explanation.sampleAnswer: Better public transport, more green spaces, affordable housing policies, and smart city technology can all improve urban living quality.
